# hooks

Generate YouTube video hooks using the Kallaway desire-based framework. Produces Three Hook Alignment (visual + spoken + text), applies the Four Commandments, maps to core desires, and scores each hook. Trigger on phrases like 'write a hook for', 'hook ideas for my video', 'help me with the intro', 'generate hooks', 'write the opening for', or any request for YouTube video hooks, intros, or opening lines.

## Use

Ask your agent to use `$hooks`, or have it read [SKILL.md](./SKILL.md) before starting the task.
